results.title: NatWest boss Paul Thwaite calls for 'greater ambition' to turbocharge UK economy
results.description: NatWest chief executive Paul Thwaite has criticised the UK government's maiden budget for lacking the necessary ambition to drive economic growth. While acknowledging the country's resilience, he argues that a true growth strategy requires a longer-term vision encompassing tax, spending, and regulation. This comes as NatWest reports solid third-quarter profits, benefiting from high interest rates and cost-saving measures.

results.description: Shepherd Neame plans a smaller brewery at its Faversham site.
